recipes.name: Smoky tomato rice, jollof style
recipes.method_note: A little catching on the bottom is wanted. It gives the smoky taste.

steps.instruction: Roughly chop 1 onion, {{ing:pepper-bell}} and {{ing:chilli-fresh}}.
Blend them with {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} until smooth.
Slice the other of {{ing:onion-medium}}. Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a large pan.
Fry the sliced onion 5 minutes, until soft.
Stir in {{ing:curry-powder}} and {{ing:dried-thyme}}. Fry 1 minute.
Add the blended sauce and {{ing:passata}}. Simmer (small bubbles) 15 minutes, until thick.
Rinse {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}}. Stir in with {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and {{ing:bay-leaf}}.
Cover tightly. Cook on a low heat 25 minutes, until the rice is tender.
steps.note: Do not stir. If it dries before the rice softens, add a splash of water.

steps.instruction: Take out the bay leaves. Fluff with a fork to serve.

recipes.name: Chicken and peanut stew
recipes.method_note: Peanut butter melts into a rich sauce. Use smooth or crunchy.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Grate {{ing:ginger-fresh}}.
Cut {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} into chunks. Peel and cube {{ing:sweet-potato}}.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a large pan on a medium heat.
Fry the chicken 6 minutes, until browned.
Add onion, garlic and ginger. Fry 5 minutes, until the onion softens.
Stir in {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}, {{ing:stock-chicken}} and {{ing:chilli-powder}}.
Stir in {{ing:peanut-butter}} until it melts. Add the sweet potato.
Simmer (small bubbles) 25 minutes, until the sweet potato is soft.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet.
Stir {{ing:spinach}} into the stew until wilted. Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Spiced red lentil stew, Ethiopian style
recipes.method_note: A warm, deep spice rather than hot. More chilli if you like heat.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:onion-large}} very finely. Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Grate {{ing:ginger-fresh}}.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a large pan on a medium-low heat.
Fry the onion 12 minutes, until soft and golden.
Add garlic and ginger. Fry 1 minute.
Stir in {{ing:paprika}}, {{ing:cumin-ground}}, {{ing:coriander-ground}}, {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and {{ing:chilli-powder}}.
Stir in {{ing:passata}}. Cook 3 minutes, until it darkens.
Rinse {{ing:lentils-red-dry}}. Add with {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Simmer (small bubbles) 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and soft.
